decision: Source-only adoption and workflow review passed for the exact reviewed patches and proposed retirement/pin workflow; hosted qualification summary is successful, with raw artifact limits stated below.

hosted.summary_interpretation: The pinned workflow executed twelve verified-byte static checks, then invoked the pinned wrapper. Under its source control flow, passed=true and no gate errors require the baseline witnesses, two profile fixed controls and all listed full/inventory/documentation gates to have completed successfully; individual commands and evidence have not been independently inspected.

source_comparison.scope: compares cataloged files only; not extra main files or a native/runtime qualification

workflow.policy: pin historical v17 client checkout to 7e91; retire completed one-off controller-join r2 matrix and loader; preserve capacity lane and main broker workflow

validation.v17_helper_guard: 8 tests and six pinned files passed

limits: The GitHub connector reports compact/full artifact identities and digests, but the bytes and individual command receipts, selected test identities, raw panic text and resource/oom telemetry were not retrieved or independently verified. A missing OOM counter is allowed by the pinned runner; do not infer that no OOM occurred from the projected success alone.
The five synthetic controller join controls do not individually prove controller wake, WAL, network, crash durability, Kafka completeness or production readiness.

The 5982-file source comparison covers the candidate catalog and does not compare extra files in main. Its sole difference is broker README prose/link; no cataloged source, tests, fixtures or scripts differ after the two patches.

The pinned v17 lane becomes a historical 7e91 snapshot and does not test future main client changes. The archived controller-join r2 evidence remains in the repository but its retired matrix lane will no longer rerun automatically.

A reviewer-run command ownership test initially hit the local 1.5 GiB disk floor under /workspace; a fresh /tmp-backed isolated checkout with actual free space reran the complete 36/6/15 source-only suites successfully.
No Cargo, Rust/native test, broker runtime, benchmark or root edit was performed in this review.
